purpose: Local VQE versus classical diagonalization of the same small active-space Hamiltonian for KDP-relevant aqueous Al precursor clusters. No surface, bulk-defect, solution-speciation or impurity-tolerance prediction.

sources.use: Section 2.2 and Figure 2 motivate hexaaqua Al(III) and hydrated phosphate complexes in KDP solution. Chemical topology only; no published coordinates or energies are reproduced.

Primary ab initio KDP stepped-surface study motivates Al/phosphate interaction and cautions against treating Al as a simple K-site replacement. Our isolated hydrated clusters do not reproduce that surface model.

cases.role: Hexaaqua Al(III) precursor reference; not pristine KDP
Bidentate H2PO4- and four water ligands around Al(III); KDP-related impurity precursor

geometry.source: DESIGN-AL-PRECURSOR-001: idealized fixed coordination geometry, not measured or optimized molecular coordinates
geometry.description: Octahedral aquo reference. The phosphate case uses a tetrahedral PO4 scaffold with two unprotonated cis donor O atoms and two terminal OH groups; four waters complete Al coordination. Hydrogen orientations are deterministic and point away from Al.
geometry.optimization: None. Nonzero nuclear forces are reported; this experiment compares electronic solvers at the same declared geometry, not equilibrium chemistry.

electronic_structure.method: Restricted Hartree-Fock, fixed gas-phase molecular geometry
electronic_structure.embedding: none; no KDP surface or lattice

active_space.selection: Two occupied canonical MOs with largest Lowdin-orthogonalized donor-O valence-p weight, and two virtual MOs with largest Al valence-s/p weight. Use all water O atoms for the aquo reference and the two phosphate donor O atoms for the impurity. Ties use ascending MO index.
active_space.inactive_orbitals: Remaining occupied MOs frozen doubly occupied; other virtuals excluded. Store explicit selected/core MO indices and full selection weights.
active_space.limits: A small chemically targeted method diagnostic. Neither basis completeness nor active-space convergence is established. Absolute energies of the different-stoichiometry cases are not subtracted as adsorption or reaction energies.

quantum.ansatz: Qiskit Nature UCCSD, preserve_spin=true, reps=1, Hartree-Fock initial state
quantum.estimator: Qiskit StatevectorEstimator, precision=0, no shots/no noise/no remote provider
quantum.selection: Report every fixed start and choose the lowest-energy valid final state. Classical eigenvectors/energies do not initialize the ansatz or stop its optimizer.

interpretation: Frozen before molecular calculations. Report convergence, Pauli/circuit resources, CPU time and memory with all failures. This is classical simulation of a quantum algorithm, not quantum hardware or a speedup benchmark. No ppm threshold, surface adsorption energy, growth rate, controller command or quality label is produced.
